markdown:
# Introduction



Conductor lets you run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode in parallel.

Each task gets its own workspace, branch, files, terminal, diff, and review path.

When the work is ready, Conductor helps you review the diff, open a pull request, merge, and archive the workspace.




## Get started [#get-started]

Get Conductor running on your Mac.

Create an isolated workspace and start agent work.

## Talk to us [#talk-to-us]

Join the Conductor community and get support from the team.

Send issues, ideas, and feedback to [support@conductor.build](mailto:support@conductor.build)

Join the Conductor Discord for community support and discussion.

Join the discussion on r/conductorbuild

## Learn more [#learn-more]

Start with the workflow, then use the reference pages when you need exact behavior:

* [Isolated workspaces](/docs/concepts/workspaces-and-branches)
* [Workflow](/docs/concepts/workflow)
* [Parallel agents](/docs/concepts/parallel-agents)
* [Diff viewer](/docs/reference/diff-viewer)
* [Checks](/docs/reference/checks)
* [Agent modes](/docs/concepts/agent-modes)
* [Conductor API](/docs/api)
